text:
maya: Quick sync \u2014 we need a final SEO + redirects + schema pass before Wed launch. Owners please.

omar: I can own redirects and post-deploy smoke tests. I will produce redirect_map.csv and test on staging. Example nginx rules I will test:
```
rewrite ^/old-feature(/.*)?$ /feature$1 permanent;
rewrite ^/pricing-old$ /pricing permanent;
```

leigh: I will add JSON-LD for WebinarEvent and FAQPage on staging and include speaker Person schema. Will keep FAQ answers short.

sam: I will sweep internal links and anchors across blog + docs. Priority links: features -> benchmarks -> pricing. Updating CTAs to match messaging variants.

growth: I will validate UTM params and GA events: utm_source=launch, utm_medium=webinar, utm_campaign=jun24_launch. Also map CTA click event as webinar_register_click.

maya: Questions: canonical strategy for querystrings? Who runs the crawl after deploy?

omar: We canonicalize to clean URL in head and strip utm at edge if possible. I will run a curl-based crawl after deploy to validate canonical, H1, and 301s. I will attach CSV to OPS-4123 and request 02:00 UTC deploy window.

leigh: Confirming canonical tag: <link rel="canonical" href="https://redwood.ai/webinar" />. Will tag maya when staging schema is ready.

sam: Anchors will use absolute paths without querystrings. Will raise PRs by EOD.

maya: Short checklist: redirect_map.csv (omar), staging JSON-LD + canonical (leigh), internal links + CTAs (sam), GA/UTM (growth), post-deploy smoke (omar + eng-sre). Reply with owner or 'ok' to freeze preflight.

omar: ok (redirects + smoke)

leigh: ok (schema + canonical)

sam: ok (internal links + CTAs)

growth: ok (UTM/events)

maya: Final copy ask: hero H1 should include primary keyword "LLM inference platform" and first 150 words should include "production inference".

leigh: Will confirm H1 on staging and post screenshots.

omar: Crawl will assert H1 text and canonical.

deploy-bot: deploy-scheduler: New deploy request OPS-4123 created for 2024-06-12 02:00 UTC by @omar.

maya: Thanks everyone, I will close preflight at 08:00 PT tomorrow. :thumbsup:
